in_marathi.name: Madhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'madh' which means 'nectar' or 'sweet'. The name is often used to refer to a god or lord, signifying the divine and the sweetness of life. The name is also associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe in Hindu mythology.
